sources.title: Nova 2 Lite - Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Names Amazon and Nova 2 Lite, states December 2, 2025 launch and 1M-token context, supports text/image/video input and text output, and identifies nova-2-lite-v1:0 inference profiles. Reasoning and tool use are supported.

sources.title: Amazon Nova 2 Lite - AWS AI Service Cards
sources.evidence: Exact-model service card describes a proprietary foundation model using transformer-based generative machine learning, available under the AWS Customer Agreement or other AWS agreements. It documents optional reasoning, task decomposition, function calling, and multimodal analysis, without parameter counts or dense/MoE classification.

sources.title: Amazon Nova 2: Multimodal Reasoning and Generation Models
sources.evidence: The 26-page report identifies Nova 2 Lite as a Nova 2 family model with text/image/video inputs and text output. Its Lite/Pro comparison tables report evaluations, not total or active parameter counts; no dense/MoE architecture is specified. The publication page dates the report December 2, 2025.

sources.title: Introducing Amazon Nova 2 Lite, a fast, cost-effective reasoning model
sources.evidence: December 2, 2025 announcement explicitly releases Nova 2 Lite on Bedrock and provides global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 code. It documents one-million-token context, text/image/video/document inputs, configurable reasoning, function calling, web grounding, and code interpreter.

sources.title: Multimodal understanding - Amazon Nova
sources.evidence: Document section explicitly supports PDF and DOCX visual/text interpretation for Nova 2 Lite. The introduction mentions speech, but the specific video limitations say audio tracks are not processed; the exact Bedrock card and technical report exclude audio input.

sources.title: Migrate from Amazon Nova 1 to Amazon Nova 2 on Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: March 18, 2026 article includes an exact Nova 2 Lite specification column confirming 1M context, multimodality, extended thinking, and tools. It discloses no model parameter counts. Document input is supported through Converse, not Invoke.

sources.title: Evaluating Nova 2.0 Lite model under Amazon's Frontier Model Safety Framework
sources.evidence: Later January 2026 Amazon-authored report evaluates Nova 2.0 Lite. It contains no numeric model parameter count or exact dense/MoE classification. Architectural references concern evaluated tasks or general behavior.

sources.title: Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic - AWS AI Service Cards
sources.evidence: October 5, 2026 sibling card checked for retrospective Nova 2 Lite specifications. It contains no Lite parameter-count comparison; its speech architecture cannot be transferred to Lite.

name.note: Official display name and v1:0 model identifier agree.

developer.note: Amazon's own model card and Amazon AGI report establish authorship.

family.note: Nova 2 Lite belongs to the Amazon Nova family.

release_date.note: The dated release announcement and Bedrock launch-date field agree; day precision is supported.

open_weights.note: Proprietary model offered as an AWS service; customization access does not establish an open-weight release.

license.note: AWS explicitly calls it proprietary and specifies AWS contractual terms; no open-weight license is asserted.

parameters_b.note: No total count is disclosed in the retrieved exact-model report/card, later evaluation, March 2026 comparison, or October sibling card. No estimate from hardware, pricing, or siblings is used.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count or routing specification is disclosed in the checked primary sources. It cannot be equated with a total count or inferred from model tier.

architecture.note: The exact service card explicitly establishes transformer-based generation. Dense versus mixture-of-experts and detailed network topology remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact model documentation and launch announcement state one million tokens.

modalities.note: Text/image/video and text output are explicit. PDF is a supported document format via Converse. The generic guide's speech mention conflicts with the exact card/report and is not adopted.

reasoning.note: Optional extended thinking supports low, medium, and high effort; it is disabled by default.

tool_call.note: Function calling and agentic tool use are explicit capabilities.

description.value: Multimodal reasoning model for visual analysis, planning, and tool use
description.note: Supported by documented multimodal reasoning, task decomposition, and tool workflows without benchmark superiority claims.

patch.notes: Transformer-based architecture is documented; dense versus mixture-of-experts, total parameters, and active parameters remain undisclosed in the primary sources checked. PDF input is available through the Converse API; video audio tracks are not processed.

summary: Adds documented proprietary licensing and transformer-based architecture. Confirms release, identity, 1M context, PDF-inclusive input modalities, reasoning, tool calling, and the existing description. Total/active counts and dense/MoE classification remain undisclosed after checking exact and later primary reports and comparison material. Records the guide's conflicting speech mention without adding unsupported audio capability.
